The 2x2 QB vulnerability matrix integrates expected points added (EPA) and coverage probability of exposure (CPOE) against static and disguised defensive setups. This constructs a dual-axis risk model where quarterbacks are scored on their ability to handle blitzes versus static coverage. The Holoscan 5.0 pipeline enables real-time video analysis to extract these metrics, while MNAR encoding ensures robustness against missing data. The system models quarterback risk as a function of defensive complexity and player-specific tendencies, enabling dynamic risk assessment during game play. Failure modes include latency in vision pipeline or misclassification of disguise types.
